title: Base configuration template
content:
# Base configuration template

Replace every value in `<angle brackets>` before pasting. Management addresses come from [[Switch inventory]].

```
hostname <HOSTNAME>
!
service timestamps debug datetime msec localtime
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime
service password-encryption
!
clock timezone UTC 0
ntp server 10.10.5.10
ntp server 10.10.5.11
!
ip domain name campus.example.net
!
vlan 99
 name MGMT
!
interface Vlan99
 description Management
 ip address <MGMT-IP> <MGMT-MASK>
 no shutdown
!
ip default-gateway <MGMT-GATEWAY>
!
logging host 10.10.5.20
logging trap informational
!
snmp-server location <SITE>
snmp-server contact network-team@campus.example.net
!
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 exec-timeout 10 0
!
end
```

After pasting, generate the SSH key and save:

```
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
write memory
```

:icon[info]: `ip default-gateway` applies to Layer 2 access switches. Core and distribution switches route, so they use the routing configuration from the design document instead.
